description: Fetch a Swiss National Bank statistical data cube's time series as JSON. Cube discovery is limited — pick a cubeId from these documented, verified-live IDs: devkua = foreign exchange rates (CHF per currency); zimoma = money market & reference rates incl. SARON; rendoblid = Confederation/euro bond spot interest rates (yield curve); snbmonagg = monetary aggregates (M1/M2/M3, currency in circulation). Defaults to devkua (FX rates).
name: get_cube
title: Get Cube
